target.title: improve: warn before non-ClawHub plugin installs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a gap where users could install plugins from npm, git, local paths, local archives, npm-pack tarballs, or marketplace sources without a clear install-time acknowledgement that the source is outside ClawHub review and trust metadata.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a distinct non-ClawHub provenance acknowledgement path for plugin installs while leaving ClawHub release-risk acknowledgement, `security.installPolicy`, and lifecycle `before_install` hooks intact. ClawHub installs continue without the non-ClawHub warning; non-ClawHub CLI, deprecated hooks alias, setup/onboard/provider, doctor/update repair, and Crestodian-approved install flows now forward explicit acknowledgement state.

Merge order note: this is the OpenClaw-side warning step and should land after the ClawHub dependency-scanning/trust-metadata step unless maintainers choose a different order.

## User Impact

Interactive users now see a warning before installing from sources that are not ClawHub-reviewed. Noninteractive users can proceed only after explicitly passing `--acknowledge-non-clawhub-install`, making automated installs intentional and auditable.

## Evidence

Behavioral proof:

- Non-ClawHub install sources now emit an outside-ClawHub-review warning and require prompt/flag acknowledgement before installer side effects.
- Explicit ClawHub installs do not show the non-ClawHub warning and keep their separate ClawHub risk acknowledgement behavior.
- Deprecated `openclaw hooks install`, approved Crestodian plugin installs, setup/onboard provider plugin installs, doctor/update repair, install overrides, and post-core existing npm payload adoption all preserve the acknowledgement gate instead of bypassing it.
- Declined or unavailable required runtime plugin installs do not persist or act on the selected provider model.

Verification:

- `fnm exec --using 22 pnpm test src/cli/plugins-cli.install.test.ts src/commands/onboarding-plugin-install.test.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/missing-configured-plugin-install.test.ts src/plugins/provider-auth-choice.test.ts src/commands/onboard-non-interactive/local/auth-choice.plugin-providers.test.ts src/crestodian/operations.test.ts` passed: 5 Vitest shards, 334 tests.
- `fnm exec --using 22 pnpm -s tsgo:core` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
